test_title: PYST 122: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 23 Jan, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three Statements are given followed by Three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All pillows are bed.

Some beds are cupboards.

All cupboards are wood.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some beds are pillows.

II. Some cupboards are beds.

III. All wood are cupboards.

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follow.
Both conclusions I and II follow.
Both conclusions I and III follow.

solution:
Statements:

All pillows are bed.

Some beds are cupboards.

All cupboards are wood.

The Venn diagram as per the given statements:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/635737c6de0fbb0efec8673023684c7a91a38c11de682a326ddb8710f6b86a5c.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some beds are pillows. → **Follow** (All pillows are bed, which means some beds are pillows is definitely true)

II. Some cupboards are beds. → **Follow** (Some beds are cupboards, which means some cupboards are beds also)

III. All wood are cupboards. → **not follow** (All cupboards are wood, which means some wood are cupboards, all wood are cupboards is a possibility only but not definitely true)

Hence, the correct answer is** "Both conclusions I and II follow".**
